utterances.speaker: Mara

utterances.speaker: Mara

utterances.speaker: Hana

utterances.speaker: Leo

utterances.speaker: Noah

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sure thing — I’ll make a quick note of what’s covered and what’s still needed. Then we can figure out the dues together.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I think the dues are due this week, right? If you want, I can check the exact amount with you.

utterances.speaker: Pia

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, let’s check it together so we get the exact amount and due date right.

utterances.text: Mina: Hey Nell, are the club dues due this week, or do we have a little more time?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m not totally sure—I only heard second-hand that they might be due soon. I can check around and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Nell—could you check and tell me when you find out?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, right — the club dues are due soon, I think. I’ll ask around and see what the exact amount and deadline are.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — if you find out the amount, I can help cover it or bring it by.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Gus — I’ll check with the club and let you know as soon as I hear the exact amount and deadline.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I’ve been telling folks the dues are due this week—if you’re joining, I can point you to the right person.

utterances.speaker: Sam

utterances.speaker: Kira

utterances.speaker: Sam

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hey Bo, I’m just checking in about the club dues—whenever you’re ready, I can help sort out the details.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Rosa — I’m a bit swamped, but I can sort the dues soon. Just send me the details when you have a moment.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Of course, Bo — I’ll send you the dues details shortly, and we can sort it out when you have a free moment.

utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll mention the dues at the club meeting and remind everyone to get them in this week.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Vik. That sounds good—clear reminder this week should do the trick.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No problem—I’ll bring it up at the meeting and make sure folks know it’s due this week.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, the dues. I may have misplaced the note, but I’m happy to pay up; can you remind me how much it was?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It’s 20 a month, Oren. No rush — just whenever you can drop it off.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Ah, thanks Uli — twenty a month, got it. I’ll bring it by as soon as I can.

utterances.text: Jules: I can help sort that out—what do the dues cover, and when are they due?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: They cover the club activities and supplies, and I think they’re due at the start of each month.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Got it—that sounds pretty straightforward. I’ll make sure folks know to pay at the start of the month.

utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Dane, I heard the club dues are due soon—if you’re joining, I can send you the details. We’re trying to get everyone signed up by the end of the week.

utterances.speaker: Dane

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll send them over right now, and if you have any questions after you look, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I can check on the dues with you—what part seemed off?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Rey. I just want a clear breakdown of what’s due and when, so we can check it against the notice.

utterances.speaker: Rey

utterances.speaker: Faye

utterances.speaker: Jules

utterances.speaker: Pia

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll take a look and see where we noted the dues details, then I’ll let you know what I find.

utterances.text: Mina: Hey Hana, have you figured out how we’re paying the club dues this month?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Not yet—I want to double-check the amount and the due date before I pay anything. Do you know if we’re splitting it the same way as last month?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’m not sure yet either—let’s confirm the amount and due date first, then we can split it the same way if that still works.

utterances.text: Sam: Hi Cleo — I’m happy to help with the club dues. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Sam — I just need your dues payment when you’re ready, and I’ll keep track of it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’ll get it to you soon. Thanks for keeping track of everything!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I hadn’t heard the latest on the dues yet—what are they asking for now?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, I’m not totally sure—I think they said something about the dues going up a bit, but I missed the exact number.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, got it — I’ll wait for the exact number before I say anything. If you hear it, let me know?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the club membership dues are due this week, right?

utterances.speaker: Tess

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — thanks for confirming. I’ll make sure to pay them this week.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, right — did they say when the club dues are due? I can swing by and check if you want.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Ira — I haven’t heard a date yet. If you could check, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Ira

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — the club dues. I meant to get those sorted, but I’ve been a bit scattered lately. How much did we decide again?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It was $20 for the month. If you want, I can remind you where to send it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Leo — I’d appreciate that. Just send me the reminder and I’ll take care of the $20.
